message.content:
This editorial illustration features a magazine cover with an orange background and a red border on the left side. Two people, a man on the left and a woman on the right, are depicted from the chest up. Both have their mouths obscured. The man, wearing a dark suit, white shirt, and red tie, holds a white rectangular card with a black curved line resembling a smile in front of his lower face. The woman, wearing a red top and glasses, holds a white smartphone horizontally in front of her mouth. The screen of the phone displays a similar black curved smile.

The man has dark hair and a mole on his right cheek. The woman has short, dark hair. They both look slightly toward the right. At the top, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large, dark blue serif letters. Above it, the text "LAPORAN KHUSUS CEO PEREMPUAN" appears in white. Below "TEMPO" is the text "13-19 APRIL 2015" and "PANAS-DINGIN JOKOWI-MEGA" in white. The bottom left corner contains a white barcode and the text "RP 39.500 WWW.TEMPO.CO MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN ISSN: 0126 - 4273". The illustration style uses bold outlines and a limited color palette.
